answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 56 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the glacier ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the echo review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the vault gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
